usages.explain: Expresses the meaning "has many characteristics, but first and foremost is ...". Typically followed by emphatic expressions, showing a degree beyond normal. This is a word used in spoken language.

examples.content: 彼はとにかく珍しい人材です。
examples.transcription: かれはとにかくめずらしいじんざいです。
examples.mean: He is a rare person anyway.

examples.content: 小林さんの新しいアパート、とにかくおんぼろのアパートなんですよ。
examples.transcription: こばやしさんのあたらしいあぱーと、とにかくおんぼろのあぱーとなんですよ。
examples.mean: Mr. Kobayashi's new apartment is a run-down apartment.

title: とにかく => anyhow; at any rate; anyway; somehow or other; generally speaking; in any case; at least
